segments.title: Gemini just moved into your car
segments.say: Gemini just moved into your iPhone's car screen. Google is rolling it out on CarPlay worldwide.

segments.title: Talk, don't type
segments.say: It's hands-free Gemini Live. Interrupt it, change topic, and the chat syncs back to your phone.

segments.title: Set it up in 4 steps
segments.say: Update the Gemini app, allow the mic, use Gemini Live once on your phone, then tap the Gemini icon in your car.

segments.title: The catch
segments.sub: Still **rolling out** · Not tested by us
segments.say: The catch? It's still rolling out, so the icon may take a while. Not tested by us.
